html:
Quest Giver: Tilles the Sellout

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 1 of Algor's Amazing Self-Imitation Plush Doll Relics from within Algor's Terror-Dome and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Quest Reward: 20 King's Coins

Return to: Tilles the Sellout

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Algor's Terror Dome (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 1 of Algor's Amazing Self-Imitation Plush Doll Relics from within Algor's Terror-Dome and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Offer:

Private Buyer Looking for an Amazing Relic!
WANTED: 1 of Algor's Amazing Self-Imitation Plush Doll Relics. Looking for that last touch to really bring my solar powered outhouse to life. Contact Tilles the Sellout for more info.

Turn-in:

You have a knack for finding these Relics. I'll contact the person who posted the ad on your behalf.

Objectives:

  • Algor's Amazing Relic ×1

Client level range: 10–30
